page.title: notで作る、4つの論理ルート

analysis.summaryJa: notは否定文を作るだけでなく、without・until・only ... but also・A but Bと結びついて条件、開始時点、追加、訂正の論理関係を組み立てる。画像の4本の橋とA・Bを同じ形にそろえる標識を根拠に、not ... without、not ... until、not only A but also B、not A but Bを業務文脈で運用する。
grammarPoints: not ... withoutは「～なしには…しない」
not ... untilは「～まで…しない」で開始時点を示す
not only A but also BはAにBを追加する
not A but BはAを訂正してBを選ぶ
AとBは名詞・動詞・句など文法形を並列にそろえる
visualEvidence: 画像中央からnot ... without・not ... until・not only A but also B・not A but Bの4ルートが分岐する
各ルートに地図・日の出・音符と鉛筆・道標の図が対応する
AとBは同じ形をそろえるという大きな帯がある
4ルートの先に助動詞MODALゲートが描かれている
commonTraps: not untilを「～までずっとする」と逆に解釈する
not withoutを単純なwithoutと同じにする
not only A but also BでAとBの形をそろえない
not A but Bで否定対象と訂正内容を逆にする

questions.prompt: The security door will not open ------- a valid staff card.
questions.translationJa: 有効な社員カードがなければ、セキュリティドアは開きません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... withoutは必要条件を「～なしには…しない」と表します。

questions.prompt: The refund will not be issued ------- the original receipt is verified.
questions.translationJa: 元の領収書が確認されるまで返金は行われません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... untilは返金開始の時点を示します。

questions.prompt: The seminar covers not only budgeting ------- also contract management.
questions.translationJa: そのセミナーでは予算管理だけでなく契約管理も扱います。
questions.explanationJa: not only A but also Bの定型構文なのでbutが必要です。

questions.prompt: Please send the invoice to accounting, ------- to the sales desk.
questions.translationJa: 請求書は営業窓口ではなく経理へ送ってください。
questions.explanationJa: not A but B型の対比で、前のtoを補ってnot to the sales deskとします。

questions.prompt: The team cannot finalize the schedule ------- receiving the venue confirmation.
questions.translationJa: 会場確認を受け取らなければ、チームは日程を確定できません。
questions.explanationJa: cannot ... without＋動名詞で不可欠な条件を示します。

questions.prompt: The store does not charge the card ------- the order ships.
questions.translationJa: その店は注文品が発送されるまでカードに請求しません。
questions.explanationJa: not ... untilが請求を開始する時点を表します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Shah not only designed the survey but also ------- the results.
questions.translationJa: シャーさんはアンケートを設計しただけでなく、結果も分析しました。
questions.explanationJa: designedと並列にするため同じ過去形analyzedを置きます。

questions.prompt: The update improves not only speed but also -------.
questions.translationJa: その更新は速度だけでなく信頼性も向上させます。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞speedと並列にするため名詞reliabilityを選びます。

questions.prompt: The issue was caused by incorrect data, ------- by the software itself.
questions.translationJa: 問題の原因は誤ったデータであり、ソフトウェア自体ではありませんでした。
questions.explanationJa: not by the softwareが原因を訂正するnot A but B型の省略です。
questions.focus: not A but Bによる訂正

questions.prompt: We will not publish the figures ------- the auditor approves them.
questions.translationJa: 監査担当者が承認するまで、当社はその数値を公表しません。
questions.explanationJa: 公表開始を承認時点まで遅らせるnot ... untilが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a required signature.

choices.A: The request cannot proceed until without the director’s signature.
choices.B: The request does not without proceed the director’s signature.
choices.C: The request cannot proceeding without the director’s signature.
choices.D: The request cannot proceed without the director’s signature.

questions.translationJa: 部長の署名がなければ、その申請は先へ進めません。
questions.explanationJa: cannot proceed withoutで署名が不可欠な条件だと表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a starting time.

choices.A: The lobby will not open without 7:00 a.m.
choices.B: The lobby will not open until 7:00 a.m.
choices.C: The lobby will until not open 7:00 a.m.
choices.D: The lobby does not opened until 7:00 a.m.

questions.translationJa: ロビーは午前7時まで開きません。
questions.explanationJa: will not open untilは午前7時に開き始めることを示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct parallel structure.

choices.A: The role involves not only answering calls but also to update records.
choices.B: The role not only involves answering calls but also records updated.
choices.C: The role involves not only answering calls but also updating records.
choices.D: The role involves answering not only calls but also update records.

questions.translationJa: その職務には電話対応だけでなく記録の更新も含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: answeringとupdatingを同じ-ing形で並列にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence correcting the delivery day.

choices.A: The package will arrive on Thursday, not on Wednesday.
choices.B: The package will not arrive Thursday but on Wednesday not.
choices.C: The package not will arrive on Thursday on Wednesday.
choices.D: The package will arrive no Thursday, but not Wednesday.

questions.translationJa: 荷物は水曜日ではなく木曜日に到着します。
questions.explanationJa: on Thursdayとnot on Wednesdayを同じ前置詞句で対比します。
questions.focus: not A but Bと前置詞句

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about essential approval.

choices.A: We cannot release the advertisement until without legal approval.
choices.B: We do not without legal approval release the advertisement.
choices.C: We cannot released the advertisement without legal approval.
choices.D: We cannot release the advertisement without legal approval.

questions.translationJa: 法務承認なしには広告を公開できません。
questions.explanationJa: cannot release withoutで承認が必須だと示し、canの後ろは原形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about payment timing.

choices.A: Customers are not charged without their orders are dispatched.
choices.B: Customers do not charged until their orders dispatch.
choices.C: Customers are not charged until their orders are dispatched.
choices.D: Customers are until not charged their orders dispatch.

questions.translationJa: 顧客への請求は注文品が発送されるまで行われません。
questions.explanationJa: not charged until＋節で請求開始時点を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct noun parallelism.

choices.A: The package includes not only installation but also maintaining.
choices.B: The package includes not only installation but also maintenance.
choices.C: The package includes installation not only but also to maintain.
choices.D: The package not only includes installation but also maintenance is.

questions.translationJa: そのプランには設置だけでなく保守も含まれます。
questions.explanationJa: 名詞installationとmaintenanceが対応しています。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with correct verb parallelism.

choices.A: The assistant not only booked the room but also arranging the equipment.
choices.B: The assistant booked not only the room but also arranged the equipment.
choices.C: The assistant not only booking the room but also arranged equipment.
choices.D: The assistant not only booked the room but also arranged the equipment.

questions.translationJa: アシスタントは部屋を予約しただけでなく、機器も手配しました。
questions.explanationJa: bookedとarrangedを同じ過去形で並列にしています。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence distinguishing the recipient.

choices.A: The notice not is for contractors but regular employees.
choices.B: The notice is no for contractors, not employees.
choices.C: The notice is for contractors, not for regular employees.
choices.D: The notice is for not contractors but for regular employees not.

questions.translationJa: その通知は正社員ではなく請負業者向けです。
questions.explanationJa: for contractorsとnot for regular employeesを同じ形で対比します。
questions.focus: not A but Bの対象訂正

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a deadline condition.

choices.A: We will not accept revisions until the next review period begins.
choices.B: We will not accept revisions without the next review period begins.
choices.C: We do not accepted revisions until the next period began.
choices.D: We will until not accept revisions the next review begins.

questions.translationJa: 次の審査期間が始まるまで修正は受け付けません。
questions.explanationJa: will not accept until＋節が受付開始時点を表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The device will not work without a charged battery."

choices.A: A charged battery is necessary for the device to work.
choices.B: The device works whenever the battery is empty.
choices.C: The device will not charge its battery.
choices.D: A charged battery prevents the device from working.

questions.translationJa: その機器を動かすには充電済みの電池が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: not work withoutは充電済み電池が必要条件だと表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The office will not reopen until Monday."

choices.A: The office will close for the first time on Monday.
choices.B: The office will remain open through Monday.
choices.D: Monday is the first day the office will reopen.

questions.translationJa: 月曜日がそのオフィスの営業再開初日です。
questions.explanationJa: not reopen until Mondayは月曜日になって初めて再開する意味です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The course teaches not only writing but also presentation skills."

choices.A: The course teaches presentation skills instead of writing.
choices.B: The course teaches neither writing nor presentations.
choices.C: The course teaches writing and presentation skills.
choices.D: Writing is the only skill taught in the course.

questions.translationJa: その講座では文章作成とプレゼンテーション技能の両方を教えます。
questions.explanationJa: not only A but also BはAとBの両方を肯定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "Use the rear entrance, not the front one."

choices.B: Enter through the rear rather than the front.
choices.C: The rear entrance is also closed.

questions.translationJa: 正面ではなく裏口から入ってください。
questions.explanationJa: not the front oneがfrontを退け、rearを選ぶ訂正です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The report cannot be completed without the sales figures."

choices.A: The sales figures are required to complete the report.
choices.B: The sales figures cannot be included in the report.
choices.C: The report was completed before sales were measured.
choices.D: Completing the report will eliminate the sales figures.

questions.translationJa: 報告書を完成させるには売上数値が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: cannot ... withoutが売上数値を不可欠な条件にします。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "We did not announce the winner until noon."

choices.A: The winner was announced throughout the morning.
choices.C: The winner was first announced at noon.
choices.D: We announced that there was no winner.

questions.translationJa: 受賞者が初めて発表されたのは正午でした。
questions.explanationJa: not ... until noonは正午に行為が始まったことを表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The job requires not only accuracy but also speed."

choices.A: Accuracy is required instead of speed.
choices.B: Speed is useful, but accuracy is unnecessary.
choices.D: Both accuracy and speed are required for the job.

questions.translationJa: その仕事には正確さと速さの両方が必要です。
questions.explanationJa: not only ... but alsoは二要素を追加的に肯定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The error occurred in the database, not in the app."

choices.A: The database, rather than the app, contained the error.
choices.B: Both the database and app contained errors.
choices.C: The app error damaged the database.

questions.translationJa: 誤りがあったのはアプリではなくデータベースです。
questions.explanationJa: not in the appが場所を訂正し、in the databaseに限定します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The machine cannot start without a safety check."

choices.A: The machine starts before every safety check.
choices.B: A safety check must occur before the machine can start.
choices.C: A safety check stops the machine permanently.
choices.D: The machine does not need to be checked.

questions.translationJa: 機械を始動する前に安全確認を行う必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: cannot start withoutにより安全確認が前提条件になります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: "The results will not be public until Friday."

choices.A: The results have been public since Friday.
choices.B: The public will see the results before Friday.
choices.C: Friday is the earliest day the public can see the results.
choices.D: Friday’s results will remain private forever.

questions.translationJa: 一般の人が結果を見られる最も早い日は金曜日です。
questions.explanationJa: not ... until Fridayが公開開始を金曜日に設定します。

questions.prompt: Every visitor must show identification. No one can enter ------- presenting a valid badge.
questions.translationJa: 来訪者は全員身分証を提示する必要があります。有効なバッジを示さなければ誰も入れません。
questions.explanationJa: cannot enter without＋-ingが入場の必要条件を表します。

questions.prompt: The auditor is still reviewing the receipts. We will not close the case ------- she confirms the total.
questions.translationJa: 監査担当者はまだ領収書を確認中です。合計を確認するまで案件は終了しません。
questions.explanationJa: 確認時点まで終了しないのでnot ... untilです。

questions.prompt: Ms. Rowe manages several duties. She not only trains new staff but also ------- weekly schedules.
questions.translationJa: ロウさんは複数の業務を担当し、新人を研修するだけでなく週間予定も作成します。
questions.explanationJa: trainsと同じ現在形preparesを並列にします。

questions.prompt: The meeting location has changed. Please go to Room 5, ------- Room 3.
questions.translationJa: 会議場所が変更されました。第3会議室ではなく第5会議室へ行ってください。
questions.explanationJa: not Room 3が場所を訂正します。

questions.prompt: The software license is essential. The program will not run ------- it.
questions.translationJa: ソフトウェアライセンスは必須です。それがなければプログラムは動きません。
questions.explanationJa: 必須条件をnot run without itで表します。

questions.prompt: The tenant paid the deposit this morning. The keys will not be released ------- the payment clears.
questions.translationJa: 入居者は今朝保証金を支払いました。決済が完了するまで鍵は渡されません。
questions.explanationJa: 鍵を渡し始める条件時点をuntil節で示します。

questions.prompt: The revised role is broader. It involves not only reviewing claims but also ------- with customers.
questions.translationJa: 改訂された職務は幅広く、請求確認だけでなく顧客との会話も含みます。
questions.explanationJa: reviewingと同じ動名詞speakingを並列にします。

questions.prompt: The sales decline resulted from supply shortages, ------- from weak demand.
questions.translationJa: 売上減少は需要不足ではなく供給不足が原因でした。
questions.explanationJa: not from weak demandが原因の誤解を訂正します。

questions.prompt: You need a confirmation number to collect the tickets. The agent cannot help you ------- one.
questions.translationJa: チケット受け取りには確認番号が必要です。番号がなければ担当者は対応できません。
questions.explanationJa: cannot help without oneが確認番号を必要条件にします。

questions.prompt: The embargo remains in effect through Thursday. We must not publish the article ------- Friday morning.
questions.translationJa: 公開禁止期間は木曜日まで続きます。記事は金曜朝まで公開してはいけません。
questions.explanationJa: 公開可能になる最初の時点をuntil Friday morningで示します。
